title: 12V Battery Weakness Proxy
dataSources: Tesla vehicle and charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smart EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, TeslaFi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / charger APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tesla:vehicle
| stats min(low_voltage_mv) as min_mv, latest(alert_12v) as alert_12v by vin
| where min_mv<11500 OR alert_12v="true"
| sort min_mv
description: Uses low-voltage battery telemetry as an early-warning proxy for the tiny battery that can strand an otherwise well-charged EV.
value: Owners tend to watch the high-voltage pack and ignore the 12V system until it fails dramatically; this gives that small battery its own dashboard.
implementation: Forward low-voltage health telemetry or alerts from the vehicle API; review weekly and replace the auxiliary battery before it surprises you.
visualization: Single-value panel of low-voltage alerts with a table of minimum observed voltage.
grandmaExplanation: It maps when the little battery that powers the car's electronics starts looking weak before it fails outright.
